                🏷 Label Rooms
                
Auto-detection only knows room shape and size, not what each room actually is — name each one so tools (and the AI agent) know which room is which.

                
Click 🎯 to find a room on the canvas, ✎ on a manually-added one to reshape it.

                

                  
                  
                

                
Drag a rectangle over the room on the canvas — release to finish.

                

                  
Click to place each corner of the room. Click the first point again to close the shape.

                  

                    
                    
                  

                

                
Drag a dot to move that corner, drag along an edge to add one, double-click a dot to remove it. Click ✎ again (or another room) to stop.

              

              

              

                🤖 AI Agent
                
These room names are sent along when you open Isaac Sim — the AI agent prompt box lives inside Isaac Sim itself, so it can add things straight into the live 3D scene.

            ⬍ Voids
            
          

          

            
Go to the floor you want the open shaft to start on, then define the void. Set its From / To floors in the list — the slabs of every floor above From, up to and including To, are cut, so that room rises multiple storeys. Walls stay as drawn — only an interior partition left floating inside the opening is hidden.

            
Select an enclosed loop of walls (Edit or 3D view) then From selected walls, or draw the outline directly. Click a void in the list to select it — the Edit viewport focuses it and its outline becomes an editable polygon (drag handles, click an edge to add a point, double-click a handle to remove it).

            

              
              
            

            
Voids

            


            
Roof caps

            
For a small roofed structure (mumty, lift-machine room, tank enclosure) on an open level: draw its walls, set their height, select the enclosed loop, then Roof over selection. A flat roof slab is placed at the walls' top — the rest of the level stays open.
